comments.text: 2026-09-23: blocked. CFPB data is CC0, but narrative text is no longer reachable: the current bulk complaints.csv has no narrative column and the public API rejects narrative fields. Next: find an archived CC0 snapshot that still carries narratives (e.g. dated mirrors of the bulk file) and pin it by checksum. Nothing fabricated. Details in the pre-registration's Deviations section (20be2ff).
